ruleDefinitions.name: Potential PowerShell Execution Policy Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the PowerShell execution policy in order to bypass signing requirements for script execution Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\ShellIds\\\\Microsoft\\\.PowerShell\\\\ExecutionPolicy$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PowerShell\\\\ExecutionPolicy$")) AND (Details = RGX(".*Bypass.*") OR Details = RGX(".*Unrestricted.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*")))
